name: vast_steering_cu121
notes: Frozen stack that successfully ran XY-control on Vast (Qwen3.5-2B/4B).
torchvision must match torch+CUDA tag — ABI mismatch breaks transformers.models.qwen3_5 import.
torchaudio: uninstall for text-only (broken wheel pulls into transformers audio_utils).
causal-conv1d: do not install from source on Vast (hangs); Qwen has slow PyTorch fallback.
numpy must stay <2 for this torch build.

Vast /opt/conda images often ship a hybrid torch: pip version string looks like 2.5.1+cu121 but torch._C is stale → AttributeError: _dlpack_exchange_api. Always force-reinstall torch+torchvision from the cu121 index; verify with a cold subprocess import + CUDA tensor.
FORCE_TORCH_REINSTALL=0 skips force when versions+integrity already match.

python.note: Use one interpreter end-to-end (prefer /opt/conda/bin/python or /venv/main/bin/python). Do not mix.

causal-conv1d.reason: CUDA source build hangs / ABI mismatch on Vast images
